Lagoon Bay Food on the Coast
Dec 2024 • Family
The first stop of Vietnam tour is the Lagoon Bay. In the afternoon, we departed from Hong Kong to the Hanoi airport and then arrived directly in Chalon. It was night and it was time for dinner. As soon as we entered the downtown area, we were caught by a range of seafood restaurants. Soon, the car lights went on, and the guide said we were soon to get to our dinner place. There is also a seafood-based restaurant, Dan Chài Quán (fisherman’s restaurant), to eat a Vietnamese meal.

Restaurant while serving our group of visitors. But it’s different from other seafood restaurants you see on the road because they don’t put a large live fish tank outside the store. Believe me, this is not a restaurant purely for visitors. And the dining environment of Tijuana House, obviously, is the characteristic of both the local highway restaurant of Chalong.

First of all, I want to commend the vegetarian food prepared for my wife. Sushi volumes are more aromatic. In addition, the restaurant made a pure vegetable meal, the wife ate very happy.

And our tour team meal starts with a roast of chicken. This Vietnamese roast chicken, looks like it's dry, but eating in the mouth was juicy. Although the leather is not fragile, and is a traditional Southeast Asian barbecue, but the meat, and the strawberry taste, everyone is happy to eat.

After that, there is a fresh taste, slightly sour, slightly bitter, and there is also a very fragrant rice taste. Indeed, eating a few slices will enhance appetite. Eating the entrance, there is also a fragile feeling. It was a Vietnamese salad.

Lagoon is a coastal city. So, we arrived in Vietnam and the first meal already had a lot of fresh sea. Large large shrimp, and fresh and sweet and brittle, good.

My first acquaintance with Vietnamese cuisine is the Vietnamese paper spring roll. We eat with pork. Add a mouthpiece of rice and fish. Hot sweetly put in the mouth, very fragrance. Furthermore, eat only rice flour and grapefruit, accompanied by fish lotion, which also tastes delicious.

The other dish is shark. It is a semi-cool dish. Because sharks are hot, and the vegetables that come with them are cold. This, maybe the taste of Vietnam. This dish of shark was quickly cleaned up by everyone, because the shark is definitely fresh.

Guides said that because Vietnam is close to China, especially the border of Guangdong and Guangxi, there are many foods that are similar to Guangdong cuisine. The Vietnamese pork from the store side, is a good Guangdong, good food for everyone to eat.

Steaming fish. Although, everyone does not know what fish this is, but the mouth is lean. Use Southeast Asian sauce oil and make the fish meat extra sweet.

Simple candy grilled big white dish. Tasteful chicken, I didn't think even kids like to eat.

Last thing to say is a soup. It seems to be a very fragrant mustard broth. A soup of clean ground, plus the spots of moisture, feels very comfortable.

Although, it is not a very delicious meal, but it is better to be abundant enough, ashe meat dishes have everything. Full meal, not too much requirement, good food, and naturally eat more.
